audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot tabernacle construction text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Sabbath reminder, willing-hearted offerings, wise-hearted artisans, women spinning, Bezalel/Oholiab teaching and craftsmanship.

verses.restored: Moses assembled all congregation of children of Israel and said to them, These are the matters that YHWH commanded to do them.

familiar.text: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that ye should do them.

modern.text: Then Moses assembled the whole congregation of Israel and said to them, “These are the things that the LORD has commanded you to do:

original.text: וַיַּקְהֵ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶֽת כָּל עֲדַ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֵ֚לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Six days work shall be done, but on seventh day there shall be for you holiness, Sabbath of Sabbath-rest to YHWH; everyone doing work on it shall be put to death.

familiar.text: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.

modern.text: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a Sabbath of complete rest to the LORD. Whoever does any work on that day must be put to death.

original.text: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ תֵּעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֥ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ שַׁבַּ֥ת שַׁבָּת֖וֹן לַיהוָ֑ה כָּל הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה ב֛וֹ מְלָאכָ֖ה יוּמָֽת

verses.restored: You shall not kindle fire in all your dwellings on Sabbath day.

familiar.text: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

modern.text: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day.” Offerings for the Tabernacle (Exodus 25:1–9)

original.text: לֹא תְבַעֲר֣וּ אֵ֔שׁ בְּכֹ֖ל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּי֖וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת

verses.restored: Moses said to all congregation of children of Israel, saying, This is the matter that YHWH commanded, saying,

familiar.text: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,

modern.text: Moses also told the whole congregation of Israel, “This is what the LORD has commanded:

original.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל כָּל עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Take from among you a contribution to YHWH; everyone willing of heart shall bring it, YHWH's contribution: gold, silver, bronze,

familiar.text: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,

modern.text: Take from among you an offering to the LORD. Let everyone whose heart is willing bring an offering to the LORD: gold, silver, and bronze;

original.text: קְח֨וּ מֵֽאִתְּכֶ֤ם תְּרוּמָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כֹּ֚ל נְדִ֣יב לִבּ֔וֹ יְבִיאֶ֕הָ אֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת

verses.restored: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats' hair,

familiar.text: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,

modern.text: blue, purple, and scarlet yarn; fine linen and goat hair;

original.text: וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ וְעִזִּֽים

verses.restored: reddened ram skins, durable hides, acacia wood,

familiar.text: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

modern.text: ram skins dyed red and fine leather; acacia wood;

original.text: וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַעֲצֵ֥י שִׂטִּֽים

verses.restored: oil for light, spices for anointing oil and fragrant incense,

familiar.text: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

modern.text: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

original.text: וְשֶׁ֖מֶן לַמָּא֑וֹר וּבְשָׂמִים֙ לְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים

verses.restored: onyx stones and stones for setting, for ephod and breastpiece.

familiar.text: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.

modern.text: and onyx stones and gemstones to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece. The Skilled Craftsmen

original.text: וְאַ֨בְנֵי שֹׁ֔הַם וְאַבְנֵ֖י מִלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפ֖וֹד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן

verses.restored: Every wise-hearted one among you shall come and make all that YHWH commanded:

familiar.text: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;

modern.text: Let every skilled craftsman among you come and make everything that the LORD has commanded:

original.text: וְכָל חֲכַם לֵ֖ב בָּכֶ֑ם יָבֹ֣אוּ וְיַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: dwelling-place, its tent and covering, clasps, frames, bars, pillars, and bases;

familiar.text: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,

modern.text: the tabernacle with its tent and covering, its clasps and frames, its crossbars, posts, and bases;

original.text: אֶת הַ֨מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן אֶֽת אָהֳל֖וֹ וְאֶת מִכְסֵ֑הוּ אֶת קְרָסָיו֙ וְאֶת קְרָשָׁ֔יו אֶת בְּרִיחָ֕ו אֶת עַמֻּדָ֖יו וְאֶת אֲדָנָֽיו

verses.restored: ark and its poles, cover, and veil of screen;

familiar.text: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,

modern.text: the ark with its poles and mercy seat, and the veil to shield it;

original.text: אֶת הָאָרֹ֥ן וְאֶת בַּדָּ֖יו אֶת הַכַּפֹּ֑רֶת וְאֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַמָּסָֽךְ

verses.restored: table and its poles and all its vessels, and bread of presence/faces;

familiar.text: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,

modern.text: the table with its poles, all its utensils, and the Bread of the Presence;

original.text: אֶת הַשֻּׁלְחָ֥ן וְאֶת בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים

verses.restored: lampstand for light, its vessels and lamps, and oil for light;

familiar.text: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,

modern.text: the lampstand for light with its accessories and lamps and oil for the light;

original.text: וְאֶת מְנֹרַ֧ת הַמָּא֛וֹר וְאֶת כֵּלֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת נֵרֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַמָּאֽוֹר

verses.restored: incense altar and its poles, anointing oil and fragrant incense, and screen of entrance at entrance of dwelling-place;

familiar.text: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,

modern.text: the altar of incense with its poles; the anointing oil and fragrant incense; the curtain for the doorway at the entrance to the tabernacle;

original.text: וְאֶת מִזְבַּ֤ח הַקְּטֹ֨רֶת֙ וְאֶת בַּדָּ֔יו וְאֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֑ים וְאֶת מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לְפֶ֥תַח הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן

verses.restored: altar of burnt offering with its bronze grating, poles, and all its vessels, basin and its stand;

familiar.text: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

modern.text: the altar of burnt offering with its bronze grate, its poles, and all its utensils; the basin with its stand;

original.text: אֵ֣ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֗ה וְאֶת מִכְבַּ֤ר הַנְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר ל֔וֹ אֶת בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑יו אֶת הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת כַּנּֽוֹ

verses.restored: hangings of court, its pillars and bases, and screen for gate of court;

familiar.text: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,

modern.text: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the gate of the courtyard;

original.text: אֵ֚ת קַלְעֵ֣י הֶחָצֵ֔ר אֶת עַמֻּדָ֖יו וְאֶת אֲדָנֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶחָצֵֽר

verses.restored: pegs of dwelling-place, pegs of court, and their cords;

familiar.text: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,

modern.text: the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard, along with their ropes;

original.text: אֶת יִתְדֹ֧ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְאֶת יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶחָצֵ֖ר וְאֶת מֵיתְרֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: woven garments for ministering in holy place, holy garments for Aaron the priest, and garments of his sons to serve as priests.

familiar.text: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

modern.text: and the woven garments for ministering in the holy place—both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests.” The People Offer Gifts

original.text: אֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י הַשְּׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן

verses.restored: All congregation of children of Israel went out from before Moses.

familiar.text: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

modern.text: Then the whole congregation of Israel withdrew from the presence of Moses.

original.text: וַיֵּֽצְא֛וּ כָּל עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִלִּפְנֵ֥י מֹשֶֽׁה

verses.restored: They came, every person whose heart lifted one, and everyone whose spirit made one willing; they brought YHWH's contribution for work of tent of meeting, for all its service, and for holy garments.

familiar.text: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD’s offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.

modern.text: And everyone whose heart stirred him and whose spirit prompted him came and brought an offering to the LORD for the work on the Tent of Meeting, for all its services, and for the holy garments.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ כָּל אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר נְשָׂא֣וֹ לִבּ֑וֹ וְכֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נָדְבָ֨ה רוּח֜וֹ אֹת֗וֹ הֵ֠בִיאוּ אֶת תְּרוּמַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה לִמְלֶ֨אכֶת אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ וּלְכָל עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ וּלְבִגְדֵ֖י הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ

verses.restored: They came, men along with women, everyone willing of heart; they brought brooch, earring, ring, and ornament, every gold vessel, and everyone who waved wave offering of gold to YHWH.

familiar.text: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the LORD.

modern.text: So all who had willing hearts, both men and women, came and brought brooches and earrings, rings and necklaces, and all kinds of gold jewelry. And they all presented their gold as a wave offering to the LORD.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים עַל הַנָּשִׁ֑ים כֹּ֣ל נְדִ֣יב לֵ֗ב הֵ֠בִיאוּ חָ֣ח וָנֶ֜זֶם וְטַבַּ֤עַת וְכוּמָז֙ כָּל כְּלִ֣י זָהָ֔ב וְכָל אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵנִ֛יף תְּנוּפַ֥ת זָהָ֖ב לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Everyone with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats' hair, reddened ram skins, and durable hides brought them.

familiar.text: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers’ skins, brought them.

modern.text: Everyone who had blue, purple, or scarlet yarn, or fine linen, goat hair, ram skins dyed red, or articles of fine leather, brought them.

original.text: וְכָל אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָ֣א אִתּ֗וֹ תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ וְעִזִּ֑ים וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים הֵבִֽיאוּ

verses.restored: Everyone contributing contribution of silver and bronze brought YHWH's contribution; and everyone with whom was found acacia wood for any work of service brought it.

familiar.text: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD’s offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.

modern.text: And all who could present an offering of silver or bronze brought it as a contribution to the LORD. Also, everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the service brought it.

original.text: כָּל מֵרִ֗ים תְּר֤וּמַת כֶּ֨סֶף֙ וּנְחֹ֔שֶׁת הֵבִ֕יאוּ אֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְכֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נִמְצָ֨א אִתּ֜וֹ עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֛ים לְכָל מְלֶ֥אכֶת הָעֲבֹדָ֖ה הֵבִֽיאוּ

verses.restored: Every wise-hearted woman spun with her hands, and they brought what they spun: blue, purple, scarlet, and fine linen.

familiar.text: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.

modern.text: Every skilled woman spun with her hands and brought what she had spun: blue, purple, or scarlet yarn, or fine linen.

original.text: וְכָל אִשָּׁ֥ה חַכְמַת לֵ֖ב בְּיָדֶ֣יהָ טָו֑וּ וַיָּבִ֣יאוּ מַטְוֶ֗ה אֶֽת הַתְּכֵ֨לֶת֙ וְאֶת הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן אֶת תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וְאֶת הַשֵּֽׁשׁ

verses.restored: All women whose heart lifted them in wisdom spun goats' hair.

familiar.text: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats’ hair.

modern.text: And all the skilled women whose hearts were stirred spun the goat hair.

original.text: וְכָל הַ֨נָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָשָׂ֥א לִבָּ֛ן אֹתָ֖נָה בְּחָכְמָ֑ה טָו֖וּ אֶת הָעִזִּֽים

verses.restored: The leaders brought onyx stones and stones for setting, for ephod and breastpiece,

familiar.text: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;

modern.text: The leaders brought onyx stones and gemstones to mount on the ephod and breastpiece,

original.text: וְהַנְּשִׂאִ֣ם הֵבִ֔יאוּ אֵ֚ת אַבְנֵ֣י הַשֹּׁ֔הַם וְאֵ֖ת אַבְנֵ֣י הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפ֖וֹד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן

verses.restored: and spice and oil for light, anointing oil, and fragrant incense.

familiar.text: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

modern.text: as well as spices and olive oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.

original.text: וְאֶת הַבֹּ֖שֶׂם וְאֶת הַשָּׁ֑מֶן לְמָא֕וֹר וּלְשֶׁ֨מֶן֙ הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים

verses.restored: Every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all work that YHWH commanded by hand of Moses—the children of Israel brought freewill offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.

modern.text: So all the men and women of the Israelites whose hearts prompted them brought a freewill offering to the LORD for all the work that the LORD through Moses had commanded them to do. Bezalel and Oholiab (Exodus 31:1–11)

original.text: כָּל אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָדַ֣ב לִבָּם֮ אֹתָם֒ לְהָבִיא֙ לְכָל הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּיַד מֹשֶׁ֑ה הֵבִ֧יאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל נְדָבָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: Moses said to children of Israel, See, YHWH called by name Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of tribe of Judah.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

modern.text: Then Moses said to the Israelites, “See, the LORD has called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רְא֛וּ קָרָ֥א יְהוָ֖ה בְּשֵׁ֑ם בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן אוּרִ֥י בֶן ח֖וּר לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה

verses.restored: He filled him with Spirit of Divine, in wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and every craft,

familiar.text: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;

modern.text: And He has filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship,

original.text: וַיְמַלֵּ֥א אֹת֖וֹ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּחָכְמָ֛ה בִּתְבוּנָ֥ה וּבְדַ֖עַת וּבְכָל מְלָאכָֽה

verses.restored: to devise designs, to work in gold, silver, and bronze,

familiar.text: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

modern.text: to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze,

original.text: וְלַחְשֹׁ֖ב מַֽחַשָׁבֹ֑ת לַעֲשֹׂ֛ת בַּזָּהָ֥ב וּבַכֶּ֖סֶף וּבַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת

verses.restored: in cutting stones for setting and in carving wood, to make in every skilled craft.

familiar.text: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.

modern.text: to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every artistic craft.

original.text: וּבַחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת אֶ֛בֶן לְמַלֹּ֖את וּבַחֲרֹ֣שֶׁת עֵ֑ץ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּכָל מְלֶ֥אכֶת מַחֲשָֽׁבֶת

verses.restored: And he put in his heart to teach, he and Oholiab son of Ahisamach of tribe of Dan.

familiar.text: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

modern.text: And the LORD has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.

original.text: וּלְהוֹרֹ֖ת נָתַ֣ן בְּלִבּ֑וֹ ה֕וּא וְאָֽהֳלִיאָ֥ב בֶּן אֲחִיסָמָ֖ךְ לְמַטֵּה דָֽן

verses.restored: He filled them with wisdom of heart to do every work of engraver, designer, embroiderer in blue, purple, scarlet, and fine linen, and weaver, doers of every work and devisers of designs.

familiar.text: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.

modern.text: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as engravers, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and as weavers—as artistic designers of every kind of craft.

original.text: מִלֵּ֨א אֹתָ֜ם חָכְמַת לֵ֗ב לַעֲשׂוֹת֮ כָּל מְלֶ֣אכֶת חָרָ֣שׁ וְחֹשֵׁב֒ וְרֹקֵ֞ם בַּתְּכֵ֣לֶת וּבָֽאַרְגָּמָ֗ן בְּתוֹלַ֧עַת הַשָּׁנִ֛י וּבַשֵּׁ֖שׁ וְאֹרֵ֑ג עֹשֵׂי֙ כָּל מְלָאכָ֔ה וְחֹשְׁבֵ֖י מַחֲשָׁבֹֽת

translation_notes: The construction section begins with Sabbath: even holy work is bounded by rest.
Contribution is freewill and willing-hearted, not coercive collection.
Women are explicitly wise-hearted artisan contributors, spinning linen and goats' hair.
Bezalel and Oholiab are not only artisans but teachers; craft wisdom is transmissible Spirit-gift.
safety_note: Do not use the Sabbath penalty as modern coercive practice. The governing frame is that sacred work itself submits to rest, and holy making arises from willing hearts and wise craft.
